name: Oneclicktheme - Get free UI resources
summary: dev.to post introducing OneClickTheme, a blog of free UI kits, Sketch and Figma freebies, templates and fonts.
description: A short dev.to post by Nirazan Basnet for IntegridSolutions introducing OneClickTheme, a personal collection blog of free design resources: handpicked freebies and UI kits as Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, InVision Studio, Photoshop and Illustrator files, plus HTML website templates, fonts and illustrations.
